title: The squared Vandermonde polynomial is symmetric
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, the integer multivariate polynomial P = ∏ (i,j) ∈ Fin n × Fin n with i < j, (X_i − X_j)² is invariant under every permutation of its variables, hence is symmetric.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, MvPolynomial.IsSymmetric ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ij : Fin n × Fin n => ij.1 < ij.2)).prod (fun ij => ((MvPolynomial.X ij.1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℤ) - MvPolynomial.X ij.2) ^ 2))
